result:
I’d make a safe childhood universal.

Not a perfect childhood, or one without sadness. Just one where no child has to fear hunger, violence, or being left entirely alone—and where someone reliably cares that they’re there.

So much of what goes wrong later begins with people learning, very early, that the world is dangerous and they don’t matter. I’d change that first lesson.
